message.content:
An editorial illustration from "TEMPO" magazine dated "25-31 MARET 2024" features three caricatured men against an off-white background. The man in the center, depicted as a large, round figure in a light purple long-sleeved shirt, has a frustrated expression. He holds a flat, wooden chair seat in both hands. To his left, a man in a yellow jacket smiles, holding the wooden back of a chair and two separate wooden legs. On the right, a man in a white long-sleeved shirt holds two more wooden chair legs. The chair parts are light brown with visible wood grain. The men's hands grasp the various detached components of a chair.

The large red text "TEMPO" dominates the top center. Below the central figure, the text reads "SALING KUNCI KURSI MENTERI" in bold black letters. Smaller text below states: "Partai pendukung presiden terpilih Prabowo Subianto mulai meminta jatah menteri. Jokowi menginginkan sejumlah posisi. H.24". The top left corner contains text about "Sengkarut Relokasi Warga Pulau Rempang H.82," and the top right mentions "Skenario Pembentukan Induk BUMN Baru H.70." A barcode and QR code are in the bottom right corner.
